_doc: Champion registry. THE comparator for every new variant (campaign.yaml: comparator.primary=champion). Updated ONLY after a full cycle passes confirm + critic + audit. Hand-editing this file is a protocol violation; use autoresearch/update_sota.py.

_schema.champion: variant id that currently holds the dataset
_schema.pct_mean: exact feedforward percentage, mean over seeds
_schema.role: role of the result JSONs used (implement|verify|confirm)
_schema.evidence: glob of results/*.json backing this row
_schema.wall_clock_s_approx: approximate per-run wall clock; recompute from JSONs before quoting

connectome.pipeline: H02 greedy-FAS warm-start -> run_rocket(20k) -> under-relaxed two-phase exact-gain sift (alpha=0.7, k_full=6, max_sweeps=40)

runner_up.note: H30 at max_sweeps=40; H35 beats it by +0.0983 pp, CI lower +0.0759

microns.pipeline: H02 greedy-FAS warm-start -> run_rocket(80k) -> Jacobi full-range exact-gain sift (max_sweeps=12)

runner_up.note: H35 loses 0.0019 pp here ONLY because the microns sweep cap is 12, giving just 6 under-relaxed sweeps (k_full=6). Known, documented, and the target of queue item H37.

mouse.pipeline: H02 -> run_rocket(5k) -> Jacobi full-range exact-gain sift

runner_up.note: exact tie; mouse is saturated and is a non-inferiority check only

connectome.reference_source: data/best_solution (35,463,823 / 41,912,141); independently reached by Vahidi 2025 (arXiv:2506.13799) with greedy + bounded-span insertion + SCC, no MIP
connectome.note: This is a REFERENCE, not a bound. Beating it is the stretch goal. It must never appear inside any algorithm.
